note: Export side is factually confirmed: real outbound customs entries from Tuglakabad ICD to Colombo, Sri Lanka, dated 2025-07-18, B/L 3684438, buyer Bopitiya Auto Enterprises. HS code in the actual shipment records is 87088000 (suspension parts / motor-vehicle suspension system parts), NOT the declared 401699 (other articles of vulcanised rubber) — the declared code should be corrected to the factual 87088000 per the HS-correction rule; this is not a ground for rejection. Product line (suspension bushes, front buffer components) is automotive rubber/metal parts, which does not match the claimed industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) — the claimed industry appears to be a misclassification. Domestic supply evidence: NOT established. Web search tool was unavailable (searx connection refused) for all queries, so no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved; volza.com returned HTTP 403. Domestic status therefore recorded as unknown, not as 'none_found' — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in the free views; no figures invented). Legal name/owner 'NIRMAL ARORA', PAN AAFPA1505K and CIN were not independently verified — registries are out of scope for this role. Address on record: 1017/342, Street No. 4, Anand Parbat Industrial Area, New Delhi. Role assessment: the company appears as the shipper/supplier in export records with a single foreign buyer, consistent with manufacturer_trader or trader; no manufacturing plant evidence was checked.
